timing.recurrence: Every year from Diwali week through New Year, continuing strong to late February; summer school holidays add a May mini-peak

description: The campus's high season, worth treating as an event because it changes every practical detail: viewing-gallery slots sell out days ahead, Diwali and Christmas–New Year weeks sell out hotels across Ekta Nagar and Rajpipla, e-bus queues stretch, and the laser show plaza fills an hour early. The same weeks are also the best weather of the year, cool mornings, clear light on the statue, comfortable walking. Plan like it is a festival: book everything early, take the first slots of the day, and use Mondays (campus closed) for Rajpipla, Poicha or the Zarwani side.
crowd_impact: Diwali and New Year weeks are the extreme: full hotels, sold-out slots, slow campus circulation. Weekdays in late January–February give peak-season weather at half the density.
tips: Book viewing-gallery + safari slots and rooms as one early transaction
First slot of the day beats every queue
Use the Monday closure for the district beyond the campus
